description: Walk-forward point-in-time backtest (retrospective reconstruction, see ADR 0003): does the screening score rank protocols that announce a raise within 12 months of T0 above those that do not? Headline population: protocols that had never raised before T0.
outcome: any DefiLlama raise dated in [T0, T0+12 months); for never-raised protocols this is their first recorded raise
metric_definitions: auc / p@k / lift@50 = mean over test T0s of the per-T0 value; pooled_auc = one AUC over all rows; CIs: 1,000 bootstrap resamples clustered by protocol (or owner)

s_logit_github.label: Logistic, GitHub-only features (walk-forward; live niche score)
